findings.note: internal/fsm/judge/judge.go: attempt() discards the error from http.NewRequestWithContext (hreq, _ := ...). It is unreachable today because req.url is built from a base validated by checkURL and the method is a constant, but a future URL-construction change would nil-panic on hreq.Header.Set instead of returning ERR_JUDGE_URL. Non-blocking.

internal/fsm/judge/judge.go: classify() treats any body whose error.type is overloaded_error as the retryable rate class regardless of HTTP status, so a 4xx client error carrying that type would consume the full retry ladder with 10/30/90/120s sleeps rather than failing fast. Providers only emit overloaded_error on 429/529 in practice. Non-blocking.
